## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: very weak breadth (3/11) and narrow leadership concentration among Technology winners; major divergence across large-cap names suppresses a strong directional call.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +14.48%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing pockets of strength: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Materials weak: CRH (1W: -11.00% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND, PPG (1W: -13.44% | 1M: -14.80%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples and Industrials also showing weakness with MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND and UPS (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -11.10%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +10.83% | 1M: -1.00%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: EL (1W: -15.30% | 1M: -22.24%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -14.67% | 1M: -4.87%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -13.77% | 1M: -11.13%) BELOW TREND, PPG (1W: -13.44% | 1M: -14.80%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -12.81% | 1M: -4.04%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Materials and selected Consumer names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND; watch MSFT (1W: +4.13% | 1M: -1.04%) RECOVERY and AMAT (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%) CORRECTION as signs of major divergence among large caps.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed: pockets of strong momentum in software names while major hardware/semiconductor names are under pressure; NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth positive but leadership narrow.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials soft: JPM (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: +0.99% | 1M: -5.63%) RECOVERY — sector under pressure and not confirming a risk-on rotation.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive names mixed and showing exhaustion: JNJ (1W: -3.23% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION, PFE (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth weak and acting more defensive than leading.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to high-momentum software and Energy cyclicals (e.g., INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to broad Materials and weak Consumer Staples; style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration and major cap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%) CORRECTION, MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.17% | 1M: +8.90%) showing strength; Technology (1W: +1.39% | 1M: -0.79%) for idiosyncratic momentum. BEARISH: Materials (1W: -6.92% | 1M: -5.40%) and Consumer Staples (1W: -5.50% | 1M: -2.88%) where breadth is weak.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA resistance area to watch for continuation (NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND); AAPL support watch near recent lows (AAPL (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND); CVX breakout signal to confirm Energy strength (CVX (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
PFE (+70): Pfizer (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) CORRECTION — FDA/obesity approval headlines but price is soft, indicating a short-term distribution risk. JNJ (+50): Johnson & Johnson (1W: -3.23% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION — upgraded outlook but 1W weakness signals profit-taking. (Other high-sentiment names in the feed include NVS and ROST, but PFE and JNJ are the clearest SP100 cross-references with available trend data.)

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
F (-75): Ford (1W: -13.77% | 1M: -11.13%) BELOW TREND — recall headlines confirm downside and price action aligns. MNST (-50): Monster Beverage (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND — earnings-induced sell-off confirmed by price. NVDA (-50): NVIDIA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines are present but price remains resilient, a divergence to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with style mixed / no clear leadership. INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND and MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap divergences (MSFT RECOVERY, AMAT CORRECTION, NVDA ABOVE TREND) and weak breadth (3/11) could quicken rotational moves — monitor sentiment-driven divergences.
